criteria.criterion: a parent removed in Jira clears the local parent_id: asserted POSITIVELY EMPTY on the reduced ticket, never 'no exception was raised'
the clear survives END TO END — differ emit → InboundMutation.fields → run_differs payload → apply_inbound → the reduced ticket's parent_id is empty
with the snapshot's 'parent' key ABSENT (unobserved: read failure, {} degradation, or a truncated page), NO clear is emitted
with 'parent' present and falsy (queried, genuinely no parent), the clear IS emitted
a Jira parent whose key does NOT resolve to a local id still emits NOTHING (the original guard's intent is preserved and independently tested)
a parent that is not in managed_refs is NOT cleared, so a parent a human set directly in Jira is adopted rather than clobbered

the same-pass suppression is pinned by a test: when outbound is writing 'parent' in the same pass, the inbound clear is suppressed — asserted through _OUTBOUND_TO_INBOUND_FIELD so a future edit to that map fails a test instead of silently removing the protection
steady state does not churn: an issue that never had a parent, and one whose parent is unchanged, emit NO clear on repeated passes

every existing consumer of the snapshot parent field is enumerated and shown unaffected by the explicit-None change (a grep-backed list recorded on this ticket, plus a test that a never-parented issue still produces no parent mutation)
